title: Evidence must describe the traded bar set: test closed vs forming per leg as an IMPROVEMENT test and run whichever wins; demote only if neither passes
note: OPERATOR 2026-10-18 ~15:12Z, a refinement of the WORK above: treat this as an IMPROVEMENT test, not a demotion test. For each leg (eth_prop, xrp_pullback_2h), compare decision_bar=closed against forming net of the full cost stack, under a selection rule registered before the run. If closed beats forming, SWITCH the live builder to closed, which is a data-backed Tier-3 change. Demotion applies only if NEITHER variant clears RULE-D1. The selection rule must still require out-of-sample robustness, e.g. fold-majority. The 2026-10-18 eth_prop holdout showed closed ahead on the full history (+89 vs +75R) and on the latest 25% (+11.0 vs +1.3R), but it won only 2 of 4 discovery folds. The new unit should pre-register the comparison (a paired per-fold delta with a materiality floor) rather than reuse that rule unexamined. Item (2) above is replaced by this. [2026-10-22 ~06:40Z OPERATOR DECISION, Thursday walk-through popup, relayed by manager session_01CSwhZWiw15rVCkjsJ8Cpuh] Q: should a closed-bar backtest count as evidence for a forming-bar leg (eth_prop +9.32R closed vs -9.45R forming, PI-20261018-WCDIDFTE-0002)? Answer: "No — match the bar (Recommended)". Resolve here together with xrp_pullback_2h: switch the leg's decision bar or re-evidence it on the bar it trades. POPULATION scanned: every real-money/prop routing in config/accounts.yaml. Traded bar = builder decision_bar (default forming); evidence bar = Stage-0 harness (closed). Mismatched: xrp_pullback_2h, ada_pullback_2h, trend_donchian_eth_4h, trend_donchian_sol_prop, trend_donchian_eth_prop. trend_donchian_xrp_4h already closed (matched). alpaca_live slv/iaum_pullback_1d not measurable here (DECISION-BAR-SESSION-INSTRUMENT). VERDICT: SWITCH_TO_CLOSED on all five. No leg showed closed MATERIALLY better (6 folds, floor max(1R, 0.02R/trade), needs >= 4 folds with <= 1 opposite); closed was chosen by the registered tie-break and passes RULE-D1 on every record window, while forming FAILS RULE-D1 on eth_prop (-9.45R), xrp_pullback_2h (-5.88R), ada_pullback_2h (-2.08R). On eth_4h forming led (+12.4R, 4/6 folds) and passes RULE-D1 too: the switch there is the tie-break alone (KEEP_FORMING_REBASE_RECORD is the equally bar-matched alternative). Prop gate (RULE-P5 shape, closed ledger) PASSES on breakout_2 / tradeify_1 / velotrade_1 for eth_prop (+65 / +218 / +154 USD per life) and sol_prop (+11.5 / +1.2 thin / +22.4). PROPOSAL (data-backed Tier-3, manager executes): add 'decision_bar: closed' to config/strategies.yaml for xrp_pullback_2h, ada_pullback_2h, trend_donchian_eth_4h, trend_donchian_sol_prop, trend_donchian_eth_prop (per-leg key: flips every routing incl. bybit_portfolio mirror and bybit_1 together; mirror equality holds). Revert = delete the line (default forming). Pre-flip check: the pullback legs need #18885 (merged 2026-10-18) RUNNING on the VM, or the key is a silent no-op; not verified by this lane. Observation that closes it: the first live order package per flipped leg carries the closed-bar decision (decision_bar_ledger record), each leg's next entry decided on a closed bar. [2026-10-22 lane DECISION-BAR-MATCH] CONFLICTING PROPOSAL for the manager to resolve: PI-20261022-LOWUPW43-0001 (perf-followup W43, #19480, EXPLORATORY as_traded_stage0.py, full-span folds + latest-25% holdout) proposes RE-EVIDENCING ada_pullback_2h, trend_donchian_eth_4h, trend_donchian_sol_prop, trend_donchian_eth_prop on the FORMING arm (no builder change). Under the legs' own record rule (RULE-D1, net R over the record's window), restated on the proxy by RQ-20261022-4de5-01, forming FAILS for eth_prop (-9.45R) and ada (-2.08R): a forming re-evidence by the record's own rule would not pass for those two. It would pass for eth_4h (+59.40R) and sol_prop (+45.55R), where the pre-registered rule's switch is by tie-break only. So: eth_prop / ada / xrp -> closed is the only bar-matched option that clears RULE-D1; eth_4h / sol_prop -> either matches; the registered rule says closed.
